summary: The candidate is test-only and does not change the scheduler, UnifiedRadixCache, or UnifiedTreeCore. Its regression passes on the candidate, but it explicitly validates the already-working path after host eviction deletes the suffix: it directly invokes prefetch_from_storage from a live L2 prefix or root, lowers the threshold to 1, and bypasses scheduler _prefetch_kvcache. The original backup-only-stub state cannot be produced by the prepared base because backuped is derived from a non-null Full host_value and host-leaf eviction frees all component layers and removes the leaf. Therefore the original issue was not reproduced on this architecture/revision, and the candidate neither fixes nor tests the original contract.

tests.what_was_measured: Prepared-base GPU execution confirmed the current invariant: host leaf eviction succeeds and removes the leaf rather than retaining an L3-only backuped stub. One test passed.

At exact candidate commit, five GPU tests passed in 3.344s. The added test restored marker values 23/24 from file storage and checked an unavailable key, but manually called prefetch_from_storage after asserting the suffix node had been deleted; it did not traverse scheduler _prefetch_kvcache or a matched backup-only stub.
No production Python files changed. The full candidate contains only one unit-test modification and two prior-job report artifacts; no native files changed.

gpu_execution_evidence: torch.cuda reported one AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950) under torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. Focused tests loaded /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-125933c91a43/cache/aiter/module_aiter_core.so, allocated GPU KV pools, and the candidate regression compared restored device tensors with independent constant tensors 23 and 24.
remaining_counterexamples: The candidate never constructs a node that remains evicted && backuped after host eviction; it asserts the opposite by requiring last_host_node == best_match_node after the suffix leaf is removed.
The partial case is a live-L2-prefix plus absent suffix storage lookup, not a matched backup-only-stub span. It manually supplies only the missing suffix to prefetch_from_storage.
The complete case anchors at root after the tree path is deleted, which is the already-known post-flush/fresh-tree path from the issue report.
The test bypasses scheduler._prefetch_kvcache, so it cannot detect the reported empty new_input_tokens slice caused by counting stubs in matched_len.
The test sets prefetch_threshold=1 and uses short synthetic sequences; it does not validate the reported default threshold behavior with a prefix exceeding 256 tokens.
There is no before-failing/after-passing production change: candidate and base production sources are identical.
remaining_limitations: The exact source-issue state is unsupported by the prepared base's current tree semantics, so the original NVIDIA L40S/CUDA server-scale failure was not reproducible here. Review hardware was AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 with ROCm 7.2, not NVIDIA L40S/CUDA 13. No server/model-scale metrics reproduction was run because the prerequisite backup-only-stub state is absent. No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable; the prepared AITER library was imported from the runtime cache.
